scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.pages.config.ts && node scripts/stage-pages.ts
scripts.test:pages: npm run build:pages && playwright test --config playwright.pages.config.ts
scripts.build:portal: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.portal.config.ts
scripts.test:portal: npm run build && npm run build:portal && playwright test --config playwright.portal.config.ts
